keep_hidden includes hidden elements and template text in HTTP Markdown output

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::{scrape, shutdown_engine};
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"},\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false,\"keep_hidden\":true}}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    shutdown_engine(engine).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.status_code);
    println!("{:?}", result.markdown.as_ref().unwrap().content);
}
```
